opening.argument: The video walks through creating an Amazon Associates account, including setup fields for a website or mobile app and profile questions about traffic and monetization. The speaker then describes creating a product link and explains that a customer may click an Amazon link and buy the product. Those steps support the stated purpose of teaching affiliate marketing: compensation is tied to purchases through links. Nothing in the described activity asks viewers for an investment deposit, a required payment, or their credentials. It presents an ordinary affiliate arrangement and a demonstration of how to set it up, without claiming that viewers will earn money or achieve a particular outcome.
